title: Copilot Agent Governance & Operating Model (Declarative Agents — Build, Approve, Share, Retire)
author_notes: pricing: T3 — governance operating model scoped to declarative agents; narrower than APPOPS whole-estate T4

gov_variant: false — the governance operating model (roles, intake, ARB, sharing policy, lifecycle, retirement) is IDENTICAL for Commercial and GCC/GCC High/DoD; only portal URLs and agent feature availability differ, documented inline. Two Gov specifics captured: (1) publishing agents to the org IS supported in GCCH/GCCM; (2) the copilotPackages Graph API is NOT available in US Gov L4/L5, so Discovery/Review scripts degrade to the Agent Registry CSV export automatically. Government agent feature set is narrower/evolving — flagged verify-current.

scope boundary: this is the GOVERNANCE PROGRAM / operating model for Agent Builder declarative agents. The sibling product copilot-agent-builder-inventory-sharing-governance-export owns the deep inventory/sharing export + the Graph beta endpoint diagnostic — referenced, not reproduced. Purview DLP/oversharing/data-governance controls are referenced (the Copilot data-governance + oversharing-remediation solutions), not re-taught. Closes the specific gap the customer named: Copilot Studio agents already have publish-approval gates; Agent Builder declarative agents shared 'Anyone in your organization' can reach the whole tenant with no approval — this model governs that.

Agent admin/governance capabilities verified against Microsoft Learn on 2026-07-24: Agent Builder sharing options (Only you / Specific users / Anyone in your org); Copilot Control System agent access + org-wide sharing controls (All users / Specific users or groups / No users); org-catalog submit -> admin approve/reject -> 'Built by your org'; Agent Registry (Agents > All agents > Registry) block/unblock, reassign ownerless, export, Agents-without-owners/Unmanaged/Agents-at-risk; AI Administrator least-privilege role; copilotPackages Package Management API GET /copilot/admin/catalog/packages (CopilotPackages.Read.All, requires Microsoft Agent 365 license, Global only). Volatile/preview specifics flagged verify-current.
